- [FACT] Judgment context: The proceedings arise from the construction of a retirement village known as the Three Rivers Regional Retirement Community by Boulus Constructions Pty Limited (“the Builder”) on behalf of Warrumbungle Shire Council (“the Council”).
- [TEMPORAL] The Builder commenced proceedings on 6 November 2018.
- [FACT] The Builder seeks payment for construction work, while the Council has brought a Cross-Claim alleging defective works with approximately 300 defects.
- [FACT] The defects comprise around 30 different kinds of defect in multiple locations within the retirement village.
- [EVENT] A complex range of factual, legal, and procedural issues has arisen, with no current hearing date set.
- [TEMPORAL] On 20 April 2022, the Builder served a Second Further Amended Technology and Construction List Statement and a Third Further Amended Technology and Construction Cross-Claim List Response.
- [FACT] The Builder alleges the Council is not entitled to remedy for defective works due to the lack of a valid Development Consent and Construction Certificate.
